name: arm
$comment: X-MB3: UR5-like six-axis arm (J-MB10 geometry: standard-DH fixed parts, Revolute3D joints with axis = local z, compliant held directions kt = kr = 1e7 with 0.7-critical damping, RigidBody3D links). Drives: MSe torque sources from the 1 ms ArmPD6 firmware (quintic reference from the home to the target pose, PD, gravity feedforward from the same geometry, torque limits). TCP pose: ComposePose3D chain from the joint poses plus a 0.1823 m tool offset.
